title: Chance-Vought XF5U-1 "Flying Pancake" aircraft in flight (Fig. 8)
description: Photograph of the circular-planform Chance-Vought XF5U-1 aircraft in flight with its two large propellers and US star insignia on the wing. Text above notes the design is powered by two R-2000-2 engines with a speed range of 40 to 425 miles per hour. Captioned "Fig. 8".
